purpose: Fatal pre-2024 test of an exact Candle Range Theory model: raid one side of the previous completed candle, causally reclaim or change delivery, then target the opposite side of that frozen candle range.

smc_ict_translation.dealing_range: The high and low of the immediately preceding completed parent candle.
smc_ict_translation.external_liquidity: The two frozen boundaries of that preceding candle.
smc_ict_translation.manipulation: The current parent candle first trades at least the registered depth through exactly one prior-candle boundary.
smc_ict_translation.reclaim: A completed child candle closes back inside the preceding candle range.
smc_ict_translation.cisd: After the raid, the completed child candle closes through the open of the most recent opposing child candle and back inside the preceding range.
smc_ict_translation.draw_on_liquidity: The untouched opposite boundary of the preceding candle.
smc_ict_translation.stop: One observed tick beyond the most adverse raid extreme known at confirmation.

market.venue: Bybit USDT linear perpetual public trades

information_contract.parent_range: Every parent candle becomes usable only after its final UTC second completes. The next parent candle is the only manipulation window for that range.
information_contract.child_bars: Non-overlapping UTC-aligned child bars built from actual public trades. A child bar with no actual trade is unavailable.
information_contract.first_raid_only: Use the first registered one-side raid in the current parent candle. If both boundaries are raided before confirmation, the setup is invalid.
information_contract.raid_depth: Zero fraction still requires one observed tick beyond the boundary. Five-percent fraction requires max(one tick, 5% of the prior candle range).
information_contract.cisd_reference: Bullish after a low raid uses the open of the most recent bearish child candle at or before the raid. Bearish after a high raid uses the most recent bullish child-candle open.
information_contract.entry: First actual trade in the first UTC second after the completed confirmation child candle.
information_contract.pre_entry_invalidation: No delayed fill. If the next UTC second has no trade, the setup is unavailable.
information_contract.same_second_exit: Protective stop wins stop/target ambiguity in the entry second and thereafter.
information_contract.position_exit: Frozen opposite prior-candle boundary or structural stop only; no elapsed-time liquidation.
information_contract.source_boundary: An unresolved filled position at a non-contiguous sample boundary is charged its structural stop plus the full registered cost.

account_and_path.setup_priority: Earlier confirmation timestamp, then larger raid depth in basis points, larger target-to-stop ratio, lexical setup id.
account_and_path.top_winner_removal: Remove the largest ceiling(10%) positive 12bp setup ids from the initial account route and rerun the global slot from the beginning.

distinct_scope: Every completed candle creates a new range. No fixed session, BPR, FVG/IFVG, breaker/order block, OTE, cross-asset SMT, OI, options, L2 cancellation, liquidation or OCO state is used.

promotion_boundary.if_zero_fit_survivors: Retire exact previous-candle raid, reclaim/CISD and opposite-boundary target dependency without adjacent threshold tuning.
promotion_boundary.if_fit_survivor_but_development_fails: Retire selected dependency and do not open 2024.
promotion_boundary.if_development_survives: Expand unchanged over additional pre-2024 dates, add exact Bybit funding and executable BBO audit, then freeze before 2024.
